title: [Bug 617189] Clarify strict expiration posting tooltip
summary: The tooltip for Strict Expiration Posting in Item Tracking Code now clarifies that it uses First-Expired-First-Out picking for tracked items, independent of the location's FEFO setting.
key_points: Improved tooltip text for Strict Expiration Posting field
Clarifies this applies regardless of location FEFO setting
Helps users understand expiration posting mechanics
quote: Clarify that Strict Expiration Posting uses First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) picking for tracked items.
